package nats

import (
	"bytes"
	"testing"
)

func validTeacherAssistancePayload() []byte {
	return []byte(`{
  "event_id": "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111",
  "event_type": "teacher.assistance.observed",
  "correlation_id": "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333",
  "causation_id": "55555555-5555-4555-8555-555555555555",
  "student_id": "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222",
  "occurred_at": "2026-08-30T08:00:00Z",
  "schema_version": 1,
  "data": {
    "learning_action_id": "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333",
    "context_type": "lesson_task",
    "context_id": "44444444-4444-4444-8444-444444444444",
    "support_context": "guided",
    "hints_used": 1,
    "max_hint_level": 3,
    "intervention_used": false,
    "observations": [
      {
        "target": {"type": "concept", "key": "go.error-wrapping", "version": "course-content-17"},
        "kind": "guided_context"
      },
      {
        "target": {"type": "concept", "key": "go.error-wrapping", "version": "course-content-17"},
        "kind": "hint_used"
      }
    ],
    "policy_version": "teacher-assistance-v1"
  }
}`)
}

func TestDecodeTeacherAssistanceEvent(t *testing.T) {
	got, err := DecodeTeacherAssistanceEvent(validTeacherAssistancePayload())
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("DecodeTeacherAssistanceEvent returned error: %v", err)
	}
	if got.EventID != "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111" || got.HintsUsed != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected assistance: %+v", got)
	}
	if got.Observations[0].Target.Key != "go.error-wrapping" {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected target: %+v", got.Observations[0].Target)
	}
}

func TestDecodeTeacherAssistanceEventRejectsWrongSubject(t *testing.T) {
	payload := bytes.Replace(
		validTeacherAssistancePayload(),
		[]byte("teacher.assistance.observed"),
		[]byte("teacher.decision.recorded"),
		1,
	)

	if _, err := DecodeTeacherAssistanceEvent(payload); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("expected wrong event_type error")
	}
}

func TestDecodeTeacherAssistanceEventRejectsUnsupportedVersion(t *testing.T) {
	payload := bytes.Replace(
		validTeacherAssistancePayload(),
		[]byte(`"schema_version": 1`),
		[]byte(`"schema_version": 2`),
		1,
	)

	if _, err := DecodeTeacherAssistanceEvent(payload); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("expected unsupported schema version error")
	}
}

func TestDecodeTeacherAssistanceEventRejectsMasteryObservation(t *testing.T) {
	payload := bytes.Replace(
		validTeacherAssistancePayload(),
		[]byte(`"kind": "hint_used"`),
		[]byte(`"kind": "mastered"`),
		1,
	)

	if _, err := DecodeTeacherAssistanceEvent(payload); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("expected mastery claim to be rejected")
	}
}
